title: A sixteen-prime-factor bound for Lehmer's totient problem and exact prime-completion criteria - research revision

creators.name: Bhattacharjee, Deep
creators.affiliation: Formerly, Electro-Gravitational Space Propulsion Laboratory (EGSPL), Bhubaneswar, Odisha 751030, India

description:
A scoped research revision of the sixteen-prime-factor bound for Lehmer's totient problem and the stated companion results. The full conjecture remains unproved.

The 55-page standard amsart manuscript adds detailed exact final-prime criteria, two vector diagrams, coprimality and valuation consequences, and a deletion-descent obstruction. The two-prime factorisation is proved with its inverse and its unresolved primality condition. New exact algebra and pivot-counterexample checks are included.

Historical exhaustive computations and partial Lean evidence retain their recorded scope. No new complete local search or full Lean audit is claimed. Deep Bhattacharjee is the sole manuscript author; earlier creators retain their bibliography credit. Added material awaits author review. No journal submission, acceptance or full closure is asserted.
notes: Source checkpoint of the accurately scoped research revision. Manuscript CC BY 4.0; code retains MIT. New submission ZIPs follow verified DOI publication; later receipt files identify that archive.
